name: @pipeworx/mcp-unpaywall

tools.name: get_oa
tools.description: Given a DOI, fetch open-access status and the best free legal copy if one exists. Returns is_oa, oa_status (gold | green | hybrid | bronze | closed), best location (URL, host type, license), and journal metadata.

instructions: @pipeworx/mcp-unpaywall forwards to the Pipeworx gateway and lists only the unpaywall pack's tools. Set PIPEWORX_META_TOOLS=1 to also list ask_pipeworx and the other gateway-wide tools.
